content: {"episode_id":"ep-05165","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents a patient with \"recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation,\" consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I48.91 and I47.1. Per the note, \"given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.\" We request reconsideration of the authorization-based denial in light of this documented medical necessity."}
